scan.title: New Plant Quality Scan
scan.choose_mode: What do you want to check?
scan.mode_sapling_desc: Nursery polybag saplings (1-18 months). Checks foliar health, vigour & graft union.
scan.mode_tree_desc: Full grown orchard trees. Evaluates canopy decline, gummosis, and psylla symptoms.
scan.symptoms_placeholder: e.g. Pale leaves, yellow spots, cracked bark, loose graft...
scan.capture_view_1_hint: Frame the complete sapling in polybag against a plain background.
scan.capture_view_2_hint: Focus closely on representative upper young leaves to check veins.
scan.capture_view_3_hint: Inspect 15-20cm above collar. Clear focus on the bud union scar.
scan.capture_view_4_hint: Top flush shoots or fruitlets to assess terminal active growth.

verdict.suitable_desc: Healthy planting material. Meets nursery quality criteria. Certified for orchard planting.
verdict.questionable_desc: Borderline vigour or uncertain symptoms. Quarantined for expert review. Do not plant yet.
verdict.reject_desc: High pathogen risk or defective graft joint. Reject lot to protect long-term orchard life.
